notes.title: New Year, New Game! ❤️
notes.content:
Favorite players, 2024 is coming to an end, and this winter, a new game is coming out. With your names in the credits.

About the past.

When HOSPICE Vol. 1 was strictly a game for me and catered to my interests at the time, Cat Got Your Tongue was a game for you, and I'm so glad you loved it so much! And even though the game didn't achieve huge financial success, man. Up to 10 videos on YouTube, so I have a gift for you. Everyone who made it into the credits of the previous game - you're in the credits again! All the reviews I liked under the game were also added to the credits of the new game. [b]And for those who still want to get into the credits or send a greeting, do it now. Write directly under this post while there's still time before the release.[/b] Speaking of the future, [b]I've started a Patreon. [/b]So, everyone, desired and undesired, please support me in development :D https://www.patreon.com/fyuriy And now about the game itself, it will be an erotic 18+ furry visual novel but I assure you, you'll love THIS novel.
